span.p:
Worker
naam pdf, andar exe
-> naam / type client bhejta (jhooth ho sakta), file ke pehle byte asli type batate
worker S3 se sirf pehle byte padhe (range GET): PDF = %PDF, EXE = MZ
(magic bytes)
naam .pdf, andar EXE -> pehle bytes dekho, reject
andar virus -> virus scan bhi
